rationale: A unanimous, AEDPA-centered affirmance will likely stress Musladin/Woodall’s bar on extending broad due-process “fundamental unfairness” language into new evidentiary contexts and Greene’s time-of-decision limit on “clearly established” law, making the Chief a natural assignee/author. Some separate concurrences are plausible to (i) underscore AEDPA’s strictness (Thomas/Alito/Gorsuch) or (ii) register fairness concerns while agreeing relief is foreclosed (Sotomayor/Jackson).
